numeric_profile: F64 (DATA_TYPE_IS_DOUBLE); nucleotide bases remain the upstream byte-valued input.
layout: Canonical row-major; doitgen and heat-3d flatten their first two tensor axes into rows. Integer-valued C graph/base arrays use exactly representable F64 cells.
oracles: Full live-outs from the unmodified upstream C kernels and initializers; adapters independently matched the untouched upstream dumps.
